title: Label a form field
summary: A visible label explains what to type. Matching its for value with an input id links the two parts.
introduction: A visible label explains what to type. Matching its for value with an input id links the two parts. Your task: Click the label and check which input receives focus.
learningObjectives: Click the label and check which input receives focus.

blocks.text: A visible label explains what to type. Matching its for value with an input id links the two parts.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.
Read the code step by step

items: A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.

blocks.text: Clicking the label focuses the field. A reading tool can announce Favourite book as its name.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A placeholder disappears during typing and is not a good replacement for a visible label.
